event.title: SFSCON'26 - 'FSFE Italian community meeting (ICM) 2026' in Bolzano, Italy

body.p: Every year, the Italian FSFE community gathers at SFSCON. While the topics evolve from year to year, some things remain constant: it is a moment for the community to come together, for long-time members and newcomers alike to meet, discuss Free and Open Source Software, and explore how FOSS can concretely shape the world. And how the world, in turn, influences FOSS. It is also an opportunity to reflect on the community’s achievements, celebrate what has been accomplished, and look ahead to future plans and initiatives. And, as always, there is a surprise waiting around the corner.
Please note that the official language of the FSFE Italian Community is Italian, therefore the event will be held in Italian.
This is an hybrid event you can join us either online or in person. And registration is required by 31st October: https://pretix.eu/noi-digital/sfscon26/5188568/
The workshop will take place in Seminar 4.
